events.title: The Hatch'n'Wall Demo is Now Available!
events.summary: After countless hours of work, I'm incredibly excited to finally share the very first public demo of Hatch'n'Wall!What started as a handmade board game created by my father-in-law for his children over 20 years ago has slowly evolved into the digital strategy game you can play today. It's been an amazing journey, and this demo marks an important milestone.
